events.verdict: Trent Jr. (MIL) reaches at the ball in Schroder's (SAC) hands and marginal arm-to-arm contact occurs.
Schroder (SAC) brings his off-arm toward Trent Jr. (MIL) and marginal contact occurs as Schroder releases away without applying any force.
Schroder (SAC) goes into the backcourt to retrieve the loose ball after it is deflected by Antetokounmpo (MIL).
Antetokounmpo (MIL) makes contact with the ball and simultaneous marginal contact with Schroder's (SAC) right arm as he dislodges the ball away.
DeRozan (SAC) closes out on the transition dunk attempt and makes marginal body contact with Antetokoumpo's (MIL) right knee before his finish.
Trent Jr. (MIL) grabs and pulls DeRozan's (SAC) left arm as he spins, which affects his SQBR during the drive.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) straddles the lane line and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
LaVine (SAC) brings his hands towards Rollins (MIL) as moves to set the pick, the pair quickly disengages.
Rollins (MIL) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) adjusts alongside Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and absorbs the marginal body contact that occurs as they come together during the drive.
Green (MIL) commits a take foul on Schroder (SAC).
Turner (MIL) is already in LaVine's (SAC) path and is firming up when contact occurs.
Sabonis (SAC) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
LaVine (SAC) initiates contact to Green's (MIL) head that is more than marginal. The contact occurs prior to Green's gather and is correctly assessed as a non-shooting foul.

Westbrook (SAC) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) both step over the plane of the three-point line and remain over prior to the release of the Green's (MIL) free throw attempt. A double lane violation should have occurred and resulted in a jump ball at the center circle.
Westbrook (SAC) holds Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound on the perimeter.
LaVine (SAC) makes clean contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it away from Antetokounmpo (MIL).
